title: DocumentMetadata
description: Metadata describes the input document content. Set this in `Part.document_metadata` or `FunctionResponsePart.document_metadata` when `inline_data` or `file_data` contains a document to configure static document preprocessing.

contentLayers.description: Optional. Content layers to return. If empty, defaults to [PAGE_IMAGE] when DocumentMetadata is set. When DocumentMetadata is not set, default document processing is used (for example, page images for PDFs).
